name: SkyWater sky130A / sky130_fd_sc_hd

measurement.note: C is bias dependent: flat band collapses to 71% of the inversion/accumulation value. density_ff_um2 stores the flat-band minimum so array sizing stays conservative; density_typ_ff_um2 is the usable value. Mismatch A_C is measured from the PDK's own Pelgrom term (40 runs at each of two areas).

mismatch.model: PDK mismatch model (MC_MM_SWITCH=1, AGAUSS term), ngspice MC
mismatch.note: 1/sqrt(area) holds: doubling sigma at 4x area measured 1.98x, and the single-area A_C agrees to 1% (0.2327 vs 0.2351). MC_MM_SWITCH must be declared after the deck include; the deck defines it as 0.

cap_options.name: vpp_mom
cap_options.notes: sky130_fd_pr__cap_vpp_*; density and Pelgrom coefficient are engineering estimates, replace with measured data from a cap test structure

cap_options.name: mim
cap_options.notes: sky130 MIM deck; verify availability and DRC rules for the selected metal stack

measurement.method: 10 mV across the closed TG at Vg=rail, 11 input points
measurement.note: 4x width. ron_ohm is the worst point over the input range, at mid-rail where both devices have minimum overdrive. Widening 4x cut Ron from 6393 to 1170 ohm and raised the off-capacitance at the DAC node from 1.16 to 4.63 fF; that is the trade recorded in width_study.

layout_pex.note: device plus this cell's routing; the Z1 term is the parallel run of the two straps and will change when the switch is tiled into the array

measurement.method: transient, 50 uA load, gate and output sampled inside the sampling window
measurement.verdict: bootstraps, but the lift is incomplete: the gate reaches ~2.2 V where VDD+Vin would be 3.3 V, so overdrive collapses at high input and Ron reaches 5.9 kohm at 4x width. Worse than a 4x TG (1.55 kohm) while costing 8 devices and two floating wells. Not selected for v1.
open_items: full VDD+Vin lift (gate driver / clock bootstrapping)
boot-node keeper: the sampled gate droops ~20 mV/ns

measurement.method: bisection on the decision over +-40 mV, 9 iterations
measurement.note: systematic offset only; mismatch was not measurable, so this is not an offset distribution. delay and noise come from the transient and .noise runs respectively.

noise.method: ngspice .noise at CLK=VDD, inputs at Vcm
noise.note: small-signal at the decision point; the 1/f term below 100 MHz is outside the band, so this is the regeneration noise, not the full sampled noise

ramp.notes: single-slope ramp: step-to-step linearity and the ramp-buffer settling are estimates; the clock ceiling is the profile's digital ceiling. There is no cap array, so DNL comes from the ramp, not from Pelgrom mismatch.

sdm.notes: second-order 1-bit switched-cap loop. loading_db is the measured gap between the linearized NTF bound and the L1 bitstream simulation at 0.5 FS (9.0 dB, flat over OSR 16..64); it is not a stability margin estimate. Integrator GBW is an estimate. The decimator does not exist, so the reported ENOB assumes an ideal one.

measurement.note: f_max = measured ring-DCO TT frequency at the minimum delay code (27.64 MHz; FF 43.08, SS 13.48). The 2.7x range ratio is an assumption. Deterministic period RMS 36.4 ps at TT is a noiseless transient spread, NOT random jitter.
measurement.curvature_pct_basis: assumption: 4k x(1-x) tuning deviation fitted to nothing; flagged as unverified

maturity: pre-layout digital canary; no post-route signoff; cap data uncharacterized in this profile

analog.notes: device names and nf finger param match sky130_fd_pr; smoke models are level-1 (see analog/README)
analog.switch_sizing_note: 4x the minimum width: measured Ron max drops from 6393 to 1170 ohm, which is what closes 10 MS/s at 684 fF. Off capacitance at the DAC node rises 1.16 -> 4.63 fF, still small against the 20 fF top-plate estimate.

switch_choice.reason: 4x TG closes 10 MS/s at 684 fF with 1.65x margin; the bootstrap leaf is measured but not competitive yet
